review: 702.168e-1: x_equals_one expected carried a reasoning sentence; removed it so expected states only the outcome.

scenarios.title: A disguise card can be cast face down for {3}

setup.notes: Basilica Stalker has mana cost {5}{B} and disguise {4}{B}. The stack is empty.

decisions: A considers casting Basilica Stalker from hand, tapping Swamps.

variants.label: three_lands
variants.expected: Casting Basilica Stalker face down for {3} is legal. Casting it face up for {5}{B} is not legal.

variants.label: two_lands
variants.delta: A controls two Swamps instead of three.
variants.expected: Casting Basilica Stalker is not legal either face down ({3}) or face up ({5}{B}).

variants.label: six_lands
variants.delta: A controls six Swamps instead of three.
variants.expected: Casting Basilica Stalker is legal both face down for {3} and face up for {5}{B}.

scenarios.title: A card cast with disguise is a face-down 2/2 creature with ward {2} that has no name or subtypes

setup.notes: Basilica Stalker is a 3/4 Vampire Detective with flying, mana cost {5}{B} and disguise {4}{B}.

decisions: A casts Basilica Stalker face down using its disguise ability, paying {3} with three Swamps.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: face_down
variants.expected: The permanent that enters under A's control is a face-down 2/2 creature with ward {2}, no name, no creature types, no mana cost and no flying.

variants.label: face_up
variants.delta: A casts Basilica Stalker face up for {5}{B}, tapping all six Swamps.
variants.expected: The permanent is Basilica Stalker, a 3/4 Vampire Detective with flying, with no ward.

scenarios.title: Turning a disguised permanent face up pays its disguise cost without the stack and triggers no enters-the-battlefield abilities

setup.notes: Hunted Bonebrute is a 6/2 Skeleton Beast with menace, disguise {1}{B}, and 'When Hunted Bonebrute enters, target opponent creates two 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.' It is on the battlefield face down, a 2/2 with ward {2}.

decisions: A has priority and turns Hunted Bonebrute face up as a special action, paying {1}{B} with two Swamps.

variants.label: turn_face_up
variants.expected: Nothing is put on the stack. Hunted Bonebrute becomes a face-up 6/2 with menace and its name and types. B creates no Dog tokens; B's battlefield stays empty.

variants.label: not_enough_mana
variants.delta: A controls one Swamp instead of three.
variants.expected: Turning it face up is not legal: {1}{B} cannot be paid. Hunted Bonebrute stays a face-down 2/2 with ward {2}.

variants.label: cast_face_up_instead
variants.delta: Hunted Bonebrute is in A's hand instead of face down on the battlefield, and A casts it face up for {2}{B}.
variants.expected: Hunted Bonebrute resolves as a 6/2 and its enters trigger fires: B creates two 1/1 white Dog tokens.

scenarios.title: X in a disguise cost is the value of X in the permanent's other abilities when it is turned face up

setup.notes: Aurelia's Vindicator is a 4/2 flying, lifelink Angel with ward 2 and disguise {X}{3}{W}. 'When it is turned face up, exile up to X other target creatures from the battlefield and/or creature cards from graveyards.' It is on the battlefield face down.

decisions: A has priority and turns Aurelia's Vindicator face up as a special action with X = 2, paying {2}{3}{W} with all six Plains.
The turned-face-up trigger goes on the stack with Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant as its two targets; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: x_equals_two
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant are exiled. Aurelia's Vindicator is a face-up 4/2 with flying and lifelink.

variants.label: x_equals_one
variants.delta: A chooses X = 1, paying {1}{3}{W} with five of the Plains, and targets Hill Giant only.
variants.expected: Hill Giant is exiled; Grizzly Bears stays on B's battlefield.

variants.label: x_equals_zero
variants.delta: A chooses X = 0, paying {3}{W}, and the trigger has no targets.
variants.expected: Nothing is exiled; Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant stay on B's battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge must carry the X paid for the special action into the turned-face-up trigger (SVar X is Count$xPaid).
